segs.t: The number one biggest mistake that MR brands make scaling their brand to seven or eight figures per month is that they only focus on front-end acquisition.
They do not understand how important your back-end is. You've went ahead and spent so much money in order to acquire a customer on Facebook,
but you now, your main goal is make sure that they stay as long as possible with your brand. Make sure that they make it to the month three, four, five, six marks, especially on subscriptions.
So if you want to be able to scale your brand and you think that you're doing it wrong or you're so greedy on reinvesting into your team or that you want to be able to do everything by yourself,
you're eventually going to hit a brick wall. Our MR brand is doing $3 million per month right now and we've gone through the same issues as most operators have gone through themselves.

But we went ahead and reinvested so much into acquiring the right systems, acquiring the right frameworks and understanding our numbers so that we can scale pause, break even and maintain that scale in order to hit seven or eight figures per month.

So if you want to find out the exact way of how we went ahead and structured our business, our systems, our frameworks, hit the follow, send me a DM and I'll see if you're a fit in order to work one-on-one with us.
